title: Model Selection Flexibility for Cost-Effective AI Interactions
body:
**Bug Description**
Make it possible to use other Claude models for this experience. I'm not convinced that I'll always want the latest or most expensive Claude model for each prompt. I wish there were an easy way to change the models between prompts. Especially while I gain more familarity on the best way of using this tool. This is also related to my other FR on making the cost-estimates more up-front. I've found that my willingness-to-pay often changes wildly depending on the prompt. For example, in Cursor I often wish that I could tune the inference budget on a per-prompt basis.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 0.2.8
- Feedback ID: 0538526a-3226-488c-b1fb-76311649c418
author: varungodbole
